summary: Export and dedup workflows must preserve complete, valid user data when local metadata or binary response handling is imperfect.
reason: SQLite iterator failures can surface late, binary bodies arrive in a base64 envelope, and unknown creation dates cannot establish canonical age; mishandling these contracts risks partial exports, invalid FIT files, or deletion of the wrong route.
validated_outcome: Unknown creation dates sort after known dates, iterator failures stop export, and native FIT bytes round-trip through the client envelope; regression tests plus Go test, vet, and build pass.
